method: Retrieve full Git blob (the contents endpoint returned empty for this file size), verify UTF8 SHA256/byte count against manifest and projection, compare complete JSON after removing only bootstrap.indices, and pack stored indices as little-endian int64 to check their saved hash.
limitations: Deterministic identity/projection verification under shared custody; no external replication or new model evaluation.
JS SHA256 implementation was checked against canonical empty/abc/56-byte vectors and known frozen source hashes.
